title: eval case
description: One line of an eval suite in config/project.json evals.dataset_dir: what to run, how to judge the answer, and the answer recorded for replay. evals/_dataset.py parse_cases holds every rule here by hand, plus two a schema cannot state (a repeated JSON key, and recorded.sha256 not matching recorded.response); tests/integration/test_evals_schema.py holds the two in step.

schema_version.description: The case format's version. This const is its only owner: evals/_config.py reads it from here, and parse_cases refuses any other value.

id.description: The case's name, unique across every suite (parse_cases and load_suites refuse a repeat, naming both lines). Each pattern in this schema ends (?!\n)$ because Python's re, which the jsonschema validator uses, also matches a bare $ before a final newline.

input.description: What the case runs: a doer from evals.DOERS and the text it is given.

doer.description: The code path the case drives; the closed registry evals/_doers.py DOERS.

text.description: The doer's input; parse_cases refuses an empty one.

scorer.description: How the answer is judged: one branch per scorer in evals/_scorers.py SCORERS, each with exactly that scorer's params (Scorer.check_params).

expected.description: The whole answer, after stripping surrounding whitespace from the response; non-empty and without surrounding whitespace of its own, or it could never match.

substring.description: A case-sensitive substring the response must contain; non-empty.

pattern.description: A Python regular expression searched for in the response; non-empty, and parse_cases refuses one that does not compile.

oneOf.description: The response is a JSON object holding each field with exactly that value (compared as canonical JSON, so true is not 1).

fields.description: Field name -> the JSON value it must hold; at least one field.

recorded.description: The answer replay judges and where it came from.

response.description: The recorded answer text; may be empty.

sha256.description: sha256: and the hex digest of response's UTF-8 bytes; parse_cases refuses a mismatch, naming the actual hash.

prompt_sha256.description: The hash of the prompt the doer sent when the answer was recorded (evals.prompt_sha256 computes it by running the doer); replay marks the case stale when today's prompt hashes differently.

source.description: authored: written by hand; model: a live candidate promoted by hand.

model.description: The registry name of the model that answered: null when source is authored, a non-empty string when source is model.
